ety.text: From Latin auctiō (“an increase, auction”), from augere (“to increase”).

senses.d: A public event where goods or property are sold to the highest bidder.
The first stage of a deal, in which players bid to determine the final contract.

fr:enchères.gl: an auction (always plural - enchères - when used in this sense in French. shortened from…

fr:vente aux enchères.gl: auction (public event where goods or property are sold to the highest bidder)

chain.g: a spear, lance, pike, carried by soldiers and used for thrusting

ety.text: Borrowed from Latin sub hastā (literally “below the spear”), originally a mark of legal authority for the sale of spoils of war, later designating public auctions.
